Safely join PRIO-GRID data

Source: R/pg_join.R
pg_join.Rd

Joins two data frames after checking key completeness and the expected key relationship. This prevents accidental many-to-many expansion.

Usage

pg_join(
  x,
  y,
  by = NULL,
  join = c("left", "inner", "full"),
  relationship = c("many-to-one", "one-to-one", "one-to-many", "many-to-many"),
  unmatched = c("keep", "error"),
  suffix = c(".x", ".y")
)

Arguments

x, y

Data frames to join.

by

Character vector of join columns. If NULL, conventional PRIO-GRID and temporal column names are inferred.

join

One of "left", "inner", or "full".

relationship

Expected key relationship between x and y.

unmatched

Keep unmatched rows where the join permits them, or raise an error when either input has unmatched keys.

suffix

Suffixes for overlapping non-key column names.

Value

A joined data frame.

Examples

x <- data.frame(pgid = 1:3, outcome = c(0, 1, 0))
y <- data.frame(pgid = 1:3, exposure = c(2, 4, 1))
pg_join(x, y)
#>   pgid outcome exposure
#> 1    1       0        2
#> 2    2       1        4
#> 3    3       0        1
